group_trips.title: Singapore City, Sentosa and Mandai Bird Paradise Group Trip
group_trips.summary: A small-group Singapore holiday with a trip captain, covering Gardens by the Bay, the city tour, Sentosa Island and Mandai Bird Paradise.
group_trips.overview:
Singapore packs a great deal into a small island, and this group trip lets you see its best sides without planning a thing. You travel with a trip captain, from the first evening at Gardens by the Bay to a day on Sentosa Island and a morning among the birds at Mandai.

The city tour passes Merlion Park, Chinatown and Little India, with time on Orchard Road for shopping. Evenings are left free for Marina Bay, hawker-style food and a rest, with Indian meal options available on request.

Guided city tour with Merlion Park and the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple
Walk through Chinatown and Little India
A day on Sentosa Island, reached by cable car
Mandai Bird Paradise

Accompanied by a trip captain throughout

group_trips.overview:

In Singapore, a guided city tour, Gardens by the Bay and a day on Sentosa Island complete the trip. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.

group_trips.title: Singapore Weekend Escape: Marina Bay, Sentosa and Gardens by the Bay
group_trips.summary: A relaxed long-weekend break in Singapore with a trip captain, covering Marina Bay, Gardens by the Bay, a day on Sentosa Island and a morning at Mandai Bird Paradise.
group_trips.overview:
Singapore is made for a long weekend: compact, safe and easy to move around, with its best-known sights close together. This fixed-departure escape starts on a Friday and finishes on Monday, with one or two headline experiences each day and plenty of room to rest.

You begin at Merlion Park and Marina Bay, spend a day on Sentosa Island, and see the Supertrees of Gardens by the Bay after dark. A morning at Mandai Bird Paradise and an easy afternoon in Chinatown and Little India round off the trip. A trip captain travels with the group, and Indian meal options are available on request.

honeymoon_trips.title: Singapore Honeymoon: Sentosa, Gardens by the Bay and Marina Bay Sunsets
honeymoon_trips.summary: A private five-night Singapore honeymoon with a sunset river cruise, a candlelight dinner, a couples spa session, a day on Sentosa Island and an evening among the Supertrees, at an unhurried pace.
honeymoon_trips.overview:
Singapore is an easy, safe and beautifully kept city for newlyweds, and this private trip lets you enjoy it slowly. Your days have one headline experience each, with late starts, free evenings and a private car or guide for every sightseeing outing, so there are no group coaches and no early alarms.

You begin with a flower welcome at your hotel and a sunset cruise along the Singapore River and Marina Bay. Then come the Supertrees of Gardens by the Bay after dark, a day on Sentosa Island reached by cable car, a couples spa session and a candlelight dinner, with free time for Chinatown, Orchard Road and the Marina Bay waterfront.

Everything is arranged for two, and our travel experts will help you plan the finer details, from dietary preferences to the wedding-day surprise you would like the hotel to arrange.
